integrity: Explicit exact analytic decomposition and endpoint inequalities; five independent example constructions were numerically checked; no external independent validation claimed.
scientific_limitations: Applies only to existing simple nonsymmetric Steiner 2-(v,k,1) designs with b>v, not symmetric designs. Computed examples are corroborative and do not replace the general proof. Potential equivalent older specialist literature remains a bounded originality risk.
title: Universal Gaussian negative-type threshold for nonsymmetric Steiner incidence metrics
